coverage.finding: Superseded by C01636 (2026-10-05; was "Reviewed with limitations"): Reviewed 2026-09-30: FiberFlex Aero (G134-01) application/finishing assessment from R-FIBERLOGY-PRINT-20260928-8d6a2f7e6751, Q05343, Q05344, Q05345, Q05346, Q05347. Maker application bullets only, including orthopaedic/protective uses; no medical or protective-equipment certification and no qualification of a particular foaming state. Other products remain separately bounded.

Alias since 2026-10-05 (m368): no product of its own. CPE-LW held one product, Fiberlogy FiberFlex Aero, filed here from its sheet's boilerplate ("CPE ANTIBAC filament"); its table is FiberFlex 40D's, a copolyester elastomer, so it is filed under TPC / TPEE as an inferred filing (m368, D130).
Canonical identity recorded: Copolyester (Foaming) (Copolyesters, base polymer CPE). Aliases and disputed entries are family entries of their own.
